behaviour: Keep CGJ inside the shaped native prefix when it precedes the first missing drawing.
Retain later CGJ in operation ordering as an invisible ccc0 boundary; draw no glyph and add no advance.
Canonical ordering never crosses CGJ. Native marks moved after foreign marks retain exact selected-font catalog drawings.
Complete native clusters, joining scripts and guarded CGJ/double cases keep their native paths.

nativeInk.scope: Actual packaged prefix glyph identities, positions and total advance match the equivalent prefix without the invisible CGJ; four actual plan-selected native prefixes.

evidence.focusedVisual: Both actual strips visually inspected: mathematical/CJK variants retained, accent ordering and subsequent circles/squares/numeric enclosures visible, no clipping/geometry failures.
